title: Win-back offer for lapsed buyers
description: Win back customers who have not purchased in months with a personal offer. Re-engagement WhatsApp template for online stores.
notes: Target buyers inactive for 60 to 120 days and honor opt-outs strictly. Personalize with the last category they bought.

body.text: We miss you, {{first_name}}! It's been a while, so here's *{{percent}}% off* your next order. New arrivals are waiting, and the code is valid for {{days}} days.
